# impersonation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeImpersonation`](gmeow-eventTypeImpersonation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeImpersonation>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

A deception event in which a projected identity claim is presented as belonging to a subject other than the deceiver. Reuses [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](../classes/gmeow-IdentityFacet.md) machinery: the projected facet's [`gmeow:facetSubject`](../properties/gmeow-facetSubject.md) differs from the deceiver's identity. Email spoofing is modelled as impersonation with a failed [`gmeow:AuthenticationResult`](../classes/gmeow-AuthenticationResult.md) (DKIM/SPF/DMARC fail). A sockpuppet is an impersonation where the deceiver controls a [`gmeow:counterpartOf`](../properties/gmeow-counterpartOf.md) identity they deny controlling. Phishing is an instance (impersonation + fraudulent solicitation), never a taxonomy primitive.
